newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia palm oil market closed for holiday.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia palm oil market closed for holiday.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil market is closed on Thursday for a Moslem holiday.
On Wednesday, the benchmark third-month October futures contract ended unchanged at 1,153 ringgit ($447.85) a tonne.
Concern over the impact of the U.S. Midwest weather on soybean products kept players busy strategising positions and prompted many to take profits early in the day, said traders.
Prices, however, steadied towards the close on pre-holiday short-covering.
Friday's range for Oct seen at 1,140 to 1,160 ringgit.
